external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Hear why North Houston Association President Marlisa Briggs supports the Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern combination, citing its potential to create economic opportunity while moving more freight from highways to rail and helping improve safety on our roads.

Vena started from the ground up at Canadian National Railway (CN) and worked in the Engineering, Mechanical and Operating departments, including operating trains as a locomotive engineer. After graduating from university, he worked in management across Operations, Marketing, Strategic Planning and Labor Relations at CN. Vena ultimately was promoted to executive vice president and chief operating officer.

Vena has served on several transportation-related boards throughout his career, including most recently as chairman of the Association of American Railroads (AAR) and as a board member for Direct ChassisLink Inc. (DCLI) and FedEx.

Jennifer Hamann was appointed executive vice president and chief financial officer (CFO) Jan. 1, 2020. She is responsible for managing all facets of Union Pacific's financial activities, controls and policies including accounting, tax, real estate, investor relations, treasury, audit, and capital planning. She further assumed responsibilities for strategic sourcing, inventory management, warehousing and logistics effective Sept. 1, 2023. As CFO, Hamann also serves on the Grupo Ferroviario Mexica

In addition to her duties at Union Pacific, Hamann serves as the executive sponsor of Union Pacific’s LEAD (Lead, Educate, Advocate, Develop) women’s initiative and is a member of its executive advisory council. She is a member of Steel Dynamic’s Board of Directors and Audit Committee. She is on the Board of Directors for the Omaha Performing Arts Society Foundation and The College World Series of Omaha, Inc.

Rocker graduated with a bachelor's degree in finance from Tuskegee University.
